AR-001.title: Planned versus actual treatment differs for randomized subjects
AR-001.resolution: Use planned randomized assignment for the randomized-retention analysis and retain actual treatment as auditable context.

AR-002.title: Week 24 ACTOT is missing for randomized subjects
AR-002.resolution: Retain observed-data MMRM as the primary estimator and review fixed-delta, subject-level MI and reference-based MI sensitivity evidence.

AR-003.title: Public ADQSCIBC reference values differ from selected source-derived values
AR-003.resolution: Retain all differences with source-row traceability; selected public QS source rows support the portfolio-derived values.
